briefing.speaker: senoj
briefing.text: Twenty-one years. In 1754 most colonists were proud to be British. By 1775 some of them were shooting at British soldiers. That page is supposed to explain how.

briefing.speaker: sivart
briefing.text: And it's blank because… the Fade?

briefing.speaker: senoj
briefing.text: Because someone decided one side of the story was enough. Bring me evidence from both sides, and the page writes itself back in. Here's your question.

send_off.speaker: senoj
send_off.text: Start where it starts: a war in the woods, and a very young officer who's about to lose.
